facts.fact: The Central Information Systems Division's milestones page lists the E-Payroll system from 2020 and a revamped e-Payroll system in 2023.

MUS.note: Only portal revamps are listed; no online services or counts are stated.
The document states nothing on a national ID system.
The document states no membership, national adoption of an international standard or requirement on public bodies.

facts.fact: The Central Information Systems Division, a government unit, lists maintaining government email services and developing and maintaining government websites among its work, and e-Payroll revamped in 2023.

The Central Information Systems Division was created as a centralized service bureau for the civil service, parastatal bodies and local authorities and lists about 70 application systems developed, the government intranet and the government portal.

MUS.note: The document states nothing on local government office connection.

facts.fact: The Central Information Systems Division lists an MS ISO 27001:2013 certification awarded in 2019 and a transition to ISO 27001:2022 in 2025.
